subject: Information Theory
title: Shannon's Legacy
description: A fast breakdown of Shannon's Legacy for builders.

hook.text: Shannon rode a unicycle through Bell Labs while juggling. He also invented the mathematical theory of communication.

buildup.text: His 1948 paper defined information, entropy, channel capacity, and the fundamental limits of communication.

discovery.text: Every text message, streaming video, and encrypted transaction uses principles Shannon formalized in 79 pages.

twist.text: Shannon rarely gave interviews and avoided fame. He spent later years building mechanical toys and solving problems.

climax.text: From DNA to the internet to AI, information theory touches every domain where signals meet noise.

punchline.text: One paper, one man, one revolution. Information theory shapes everything.

quiz.question: What did Shannon's 1948 paper establish?
options: The mathematical foundations of information, entropy, and communication
